_about: Supervisor entry of the session-hygiene add-on. install.sh --with-session-hygiene merges it into the registry (<supervisor dir>/checks.json). __CLAUDE_DIR__ and __HOME__ are filled in when the registry is read. only_if_exists: a machine without the add-on (no run logged yet) stays at 0 problems.

checks.name: Session hygiene ran
checks.note: session-hygiene runs daily under bin/catchup-run (from 04:00, retried hourly while the nightly chat backup is not fresh yet - rc 75). Red when its last run failed (a session it could not process: see ~/.claude/cron-logs/session_hygiene.log) or the last success is older than 36 working hours. rc 3 = it never succeeded yet (no fresh chat backup so far) - that is the chat backup's check to raise.
